# 1k-molecule CI fixture

Empty until Phase 1. Once the raw archive is verified, a seeded, stratified
sample of 1,000 source `.xyz` files (by heavy-atom count, plus every planted
edge case: linear molecules, `*^` exponents, some uncharacterized IDs) is
copied here unchanged, together with `SAMPLE.json` listing the IDs, the seed
and the source archive SHA-256. Check the source license allows
redistribution before committing it.
